notes: Modified cash basis village (governmental modified cash, business-type accrual), aligned with FY2023/FY2024 choices. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds 2022 column (p6). Taxes 88,398 split per the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2): property 49,796 + motor vehicle 6,347 + sales 32,255 (ties to the fund schedules). Intergovernmental revenues 71,593 split from the General Fund (p10) and Debt Service Fund (p14) itemized lines plus the Special Revenue Fund's single line 54,730 (p13). Grant/Donation Income 19,646 has no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants. Payments of long-term debt principal 1,265 / interest 1,677 are printed under Other financing sources (uses) (Fire Fund): recorded in other_financing (-2,942), as FY2024 does. Roll-forward on fund balances 205,870 -> 195,706 (ties). Cash (cash in bank + county treasurer) and certificates of deposit/savings from the 2021/2022 columns of p4. Business-type statement lines from the government-wide Statement of Activities (p2, accrual): charges for services by function (include operating miscellaneous 693) plus interest income 152, expenses by function (Sewer includes interest 7,031), transfers -13,000; net position 1,065,736 -> 1,081,764 (ties). Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I Totals 2022 (p9). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), lines by Governmental / Business-type column; zero cells skipped. Detail: Schedule 1 General Fund, Schedule 3 Special Revenue Fund, Schedule 4 Debt Service Fund, Schedule 2 nonmajor combining (Fire, Landfill, Park, Auditorium, Senior Center), and proprietary per-fund columns from Exhibit H (p8). Capital outlay labelled with a function only for the Park Fund (fund name); Special Revenue and Auditorium capital outlay left as plain Capital Outlay. Not recorded to avoid double counting: Schedule 5 budget comparison (p15, fund-group totals) and Schedule 6 proprietary budget comparison (p16, totals of Exhibit H). Read pages 1-16 of 16
